claim_ceiling: same-author synthetic generator; commit-seeded protected outcomes; not independently authored, not real-family K5, not proof of GMI superiority over an unrestricted lifecycle-aware parent
current_only_parent: same nominal formulas after replacing U=0, retention=0, lineage=0; therefore prediction is identical inside each twin pair
gmi_predictor: nominal lifecycle cost formulas use N, law_bits, Q, U, dep, retention, lineage
no_repair_rule: if gate fails, preserve receipt; do not modify predictor/generator on this protected seed
pair_structure: 32 pairs. Within each pair N, law_bits, Q and dependency locality are identical; only future U, retention and lineage differ.
primary_endpoint: mean normalized regret(current_only_parent) - mean normalized regret(GMI)
realized_world: same cost equations with each registered coefficient multiplied by an independently sampled Uniform[0.9,1.1] factor shared across the two members of a pair
seed_rule: protected RNG seed = integer(first 16 hex digits of this freeze commit SHA) modulo 2^63
success_gate: strictly positive primary endpoint AND GMI worse on no more than 20% of the 64 protected worlds
